description: Plan each day of a trip with ordered stops and a route map. Keep check-ins, notes and photos alongside the plan. Photos stay on your device. Optional AI title suggestions use event times and coordinates.
release_notes: Build a daily itinerary, reorder stops, and see them numbered on the map. Attach a journal entry to a planned stop or record a detour. Existing trips, check-ins and photo events open in the new planner.
